race.comment: SHAME ON SUE (6) was plain as favourite over 1350m on heavy ground at Ipswich, but her Gold Coast Poly third two starts back reads better and the move back in trip gives her a genuine rebound case. MISHANI SENORITA (14) comes through a well-supported Mdn win at Dalby and has been consistent enough this campaign to keep improving, though BM55 company is a sharper test. STABILIZER (3) was a brave winner before the break over this trip. Hasn't been in the paddock long and has enough dash to offset the wide draw and run them along. BRIGHT OUTLOOK (7) got off the mark in style at Murwillumbah last start and while this is obviously tougher, she has plenty of scope for improvement. ALL TOO FOXY (9) has placed in all three fresh runs and her recent trial win suggests she can win fresh. Not taking lightly.
